geometry_definitions.original_continuous_boxes: Original native CLOSED uncertainty ranges supplied by sourceAIannotations. Distance is to their continuous union. This was the previous comparison distance.
geometry_definitions.native_pixel_CENTRES: Finite set of integer(x,y) centres whose saved protected mask isTrue. A positive distance for fractionalq does NOT imply q is outside a protected pixel footprint.
geometry_definitions.native_pixel_FOOTPRINTS: Union of selected unit cells [x-.5,x+.5)×[y-.5,y+.5). Membership equals protected[floor(qy+.5),floor(qx+.5)]. Distance is reported to CLOSED cell footprints (infimum; zero can also occur at an excluded half-open edge).
geometry_definitions.RGB96_central4: Four bilinear mask samples at q+(±L/192,±L/192); any positive alpha is sampling overlap, not a new semantic label.
geometry_definitions.pasted_alpha: Larger actual cover/sham alpha is distinct from protected cue range; a protected-range miss does not prove cover misses q.
